The internet speed of Iran is bad, so bad that it is one of the worst in the world. As Internet becomes more and more vital in the daily lives of Iranians it is wise that an upgrade is needed.

The Government decided that it is in need of rapid improvement to keep Iran competitive in the world, therefor there will be 2 new projects related to Internet Infrastructure.

* Nationwide Free WiMax is free for everybody to use. * Nationwide Fiberglass, only profit-based companies pay a mandatory fee based on size of company

The Cost of the Fibre Network is Estimated to be between $ 7.9 Billion to $ 11.6 Billion And is estimated to cost $ 1.400.000.000 a year to maintain.

The Cost to build the free of the Free WiMax is estimated to cost $ 6.500.000.000 and is estimated to cost $350.000.000 a year to maintain.

The Iran Free Wifi will use the infrastructure of the Free fibre for access points and other existing infrastructure.

Total cost of the projects is between $ 14.4 Billion to $ 18.1 Billion.

The deployment time of the projects is estimated to between 5 – 6 years

In europe you never get bird shit on your hands and the eggs are always super fresh, in fact better than America, and in Europe they don't refrigerate either. I don't know what it is the brits do with theirs but it's the complete opposite result with them.

If you wash the eggs (removing the soiled coating), immediately re-seal with a clean coating of oil (a barrier from bacteria), and refrigerate, then eggs can keep for months or years. I've cracked open eggs to use two months after the expiration date in the US and haven't had any problems (although I am scrambling them--no soft centers--and check for smell).
